name: cellphonewarehousebw.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: cellphonewarehousebw.com scores 55 out of 100 (D). 10 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _ga_LV7V0ZXF23, _ga, _gcl_au, _ga_8CLFTHTYN4.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 99 elements on /, /contact-us, /3-cell-phones, for example .home_icon > a and .bx-clone.angarslider-container:nth-child(1) > a[title=""]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 180 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 33 elements on /, /contact-us, /3-cell-phones, for example a[href="tel:77797222"] and .shop-email > strong > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 5 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /contact-us. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.
